action.command: DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -qq memcached 2>&1 | tail -2; service memcached start 2>&1 || memcached -d -m 64 -p 11211 2>&1; sleep 1; (echo -e "stats\r"; sleep 0.3) | timeout 3 bash -c 'cat > /dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/11211' 2>&1; (echo "version"; sleep 0.5) | timeout 3 nc 127.0.0.1 11211 2>/dev/null | head -1 || echo "memcached not responding via nc"; ps aux | grep memcached | grep -v grep | awk '{print "memcached PID",$2}'
